title: Workshop on Active Matter: Motion, Mechanics, and Emergence
institution: ICTP South American Institute for Fundamental Research (ICTP-SAIFR)
field: Physics (active matter, soft and biological physics)
about: ICTP-SAIFR holds the Workshop on Active Matter: Motion, Mechanics, and Emergence at Instituto Principia in São Paulo, Brazil, from 5 to 9 April 2027. Applications are made online; the deadline is 4 February 2027.
